title: Twelve-arm stability atlas
sourceAncestry: AETHER-059 selected gain vector, AETHER-064 protocol

authorization.condition: Measured performance alone is not authorization.

limitations: Cells are correlated evaluations of one synthetic oscillator, not independent witnesses.
One initial condition, one fixed gain configuration, one readout time.
Pass criteria selected by experiment design, not universal physical bounds.
Fusion and weak/strong/medium are symbolic channel names. No real force physics or energy measurement.
